prompt: As a student, your goal is to find the total number of occurrences of a given word within a set of text files in different directories. You are provided with a directory named "problem_directory" containing multiple text files, as well as subdirectories containing text files. The word to be searched is "Linux". Your answer should be the total number of occurrences of the word "Linux" across all the text files in the entire directory structure (including subdirectories). Make sure you only count exact matches and that the word is treated as case-sensitive.
